goal: Bring Jichi Insight to production graduation as a nationwide municipality insight platform. Continue autonomous, evidence-grounded expansion from the current Phase 15 state through full intended municipality coverage, canonical review/publication readiness, pipeline hardening, public-product alignment, and final runtime verification without collapsing fiscal/document/version distinctions or inventing unsupported policy claims. Continue autonomously from the current repository state and do not stop at an intermediate milestone while safe executable work remains. Graduation criteria: [1] The intended nationwide municipality universe is represented in the canonical coverage model, with every in-scope municipality either backed by a valid evidence package/state or explicitly tracked as unresolved rather than silently omitted. [2] Municipality evidence preserves official-source URLs, stable locators, plan/version/period/fiscal/availability boundaries, source precision, provenance, and deferred-depth semantics; unpublished facts, causal claims, unverified comparisons, and score-like judgments are never invented. [3] Candidate generation, validation, review staging, canonical promotion, and public-data workflows are deterministic, bounded, resumable, and free of known machine-resolvable blockers while preserving explicit human-only review boundaries where policy requires them. [4] The public Jichi Insight product is aligned with the current canonical nationwide dataset and its core browse/search/detail behavior passes repository and production/runtime smoke checks. [5] Repository CI, regression suites, data-quality audits, and final runtime verification are green with no unresolved implementation blocker; any true human-only publication/review gate is surfaced explicitly rather than bypassed. Keep CI, validation, provenance, quota limits, and existing human-only safety boundaries intact. Only when every graduation criterion is demonstrably satisfied and final repository/runtime checks are green, create or update docs/ADE_COMPLETION.json as JSON with schema_version=1 and status=COMPLETE plus concise evidence fields. If the marker does not yet qualify, choose the highest-value bounded work that moves the project toward graduation. When creating a not-yet-existing file, declare its exact path in new_paths.
